name: Excel & Spreadsheets
description: Organizing, calculating and summarizing data in spreadsheets with formulas, lookups and PivotTables.

questions.question: Which formula adds up the values in cells A2 through A10?
options: =ADD(A2:A10)
=SUM(A2:A10)
=TOTAL(A2,A10)
=COUNT(A2:A10)
questions.explanation: SUM with a range adds all numeric values in it. COUNT counts numeric cells; ADD and TOTAL are not Excel functions.

questions.question: What does the reference $A$1 mean in a formula?
options: Cell A1 formatted as currency
Only the row is locked when copied
The value of A1 rounded to whole numbers
Both the column and row stay fixed when the formula is copied
questions.explanation: Dollar signs make the column and row absolute, so the reference does not shift when the formula is filled or copied.

questions.question: In =VLOOKUP(E2, A2:C100, 3, FALSE), what does FALSE specify?
options: An exact match for E2 is required
The lookup should search from the bottom up
Return the 3rd row instead of the 3rd column
Ignore text values
questions.explanation: The fourth argument is range_lookup; FALSE requires an exact match, returning #N/A if none is found.

questions.question: What is a PivotTable best used for?
options: Encrypting a workbook
Drawing freehand diagrams
Quickly summarizing and aggregating large data sets by categories, e.g. total sales by region and month
Spell-checking text cells
questions.explanation: PivotTables group rows by fields and compute aggregates like sums, counts and averages interactively.

questions.question: What does =SUMIFS(C:C, A:A, "East", B:B, ">100") return?
options: The sum of column C where column A is "East" OR column B is greater than 100
The sum of column C where column A is "East" AND column B is greater than 100
The count of rows where column A is "East"
The sum of columns A and B where C is greater than 100
questions.explanation: SUMIFS sums the first range for rows meeting all criteria pairs; multiple criteria are combined with AND.

questions.question: What does =INDEX(B2:B10, MATCH("Kiwi", A2:A10, 0)) return?
options: The row number of "Kiwi" in A2:A10
The number of times "Kiwi" appears in A2:A10
The sum of B2:B10
The value in B2:B10 on the same row where A2:A10 exactly equals "Kiwi"
questions.explanation: MATCH with 0 finds the exact position of "Kiwi"; INDEX returns the item at that position in B2:B10.

practical.title: Count orders with multiple conditions
practical.instructions: A sheet has regions in B2:B500 and order amounts in C2:C500. Write a single Excel formula that counts how many orders are from the region "West" AND have an amount greater than 1000.

rubric.hint: Use COUNTIFS to count rows that meet several conditions.
Pair the range B2:B500 with the criterion "West".
Pair the range C2:C500 with the criterion ">1000" (the operator goes inside the quotes).

tasks.title: Learn core formulas and references
tasks.description: Use Microsoft's Excel training to learn SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, IF and the difference between relative and absolute references. Recreate each example in your own workbook.
tasks.completion_criteria: A workbook with working examples of at least five functions and both reference types.

tasks.title: Build a personal budget sheet
tasks.description: Create a monthly budget with categories, use SUMIF to total spending per category, and apply conditional formatting to highlight overspending.
tasks.completion_criteria: A budget sheet with SUMIF totals per category and conditional formatting that flags categories over limit.

tasks.title: Lookups and PivotTables on a sales data set
tasks.description: Download a sample sales data set, use XLOOKUP or INDEX/MATCH to join product details, and build PivotTables summarizing revenue by region and month.
tasks.completion_criteria: A workbook with a lookup-enriched table and at least two PivotTables answering specific business questions.

tasks.title: Create an interactive reporting workbook
tasks.description: Build a workbook that imports raw data, cleans it with formulas or Power Query, and presents a one-page summary with PivotCharts and slicers for filtering.
tasks.completion_criteria: A workbook where changing a slicer updates all charts and KPIs, with documentation of data sources and steps.
